title: Jewel beetles mating with stubby beer bottles

tellings.quote: So they they some guys, you know, in Australia drink them, throw them out into outback and drive off. And the male jewel beetles flock to these bottles.

plain: In the Australian outback, male jewel beetles are said to flock to empty stubby beer bottles that people drink, toss out and drive away from, and to try to mate with them. A scientist named Don Hoffman tells this, without naming a source, as an example of how a creature's senses can steer it toward the wrong thing, which bears on his argument that our brains evolved to miss what is really around us.
